title: Beastie Boy Mike D releases his first solo LP 'Thank You'
summary: Mike D rose to fame in the 1980s as part of New York's Beastie Boys, a rap-rock trio who soon tired of poking fun at frat boy humour with hits like "Fight for Your Right (To Party!)" and" Girls".
